title: More like an imperfect tapestry than a throw; hate the smell, texture, and design
text:
More like an imperfect tapestry than a throw; hate the smell, texture, and design. I am very disappointed in this throw. First of all the texture is rough. Second, it smells like rubber. Third, the stitching has imperfections in it. Fourth, the design is not very pretty or western to me. Also, the texture reminds me a bit of sisal rope that my cats like to scratch. There is not one thing I like about this; I'm sorry I ordered it.

Dry cleaning is recommended but it can be machined washed on delicate as per the label.

Photo 1 shows the front; Photo 2 the back; Photo 3 the imperfections in back; and Photo 4 the imperfections in front.

product_metadata.title: Amazon Brand – Rivet Contemporary Western-Style Throw Blanket - 60 x 50, Multicolored
features: Western charm and big-city sophistication merge in this large throw blanket. Stripes of varying thickness come together and split apart down the length of it, and oversized tassels hang from either end.
For best results, dry-clean. This throw can be washed on delicate cycle and line dried.
